sub_answers.text: In 2017 Belasteguín and Lima lost two consecutive finals to Paquito Navarro and Sanyo Gutiérrez before later beating them in other events [d83147937s5p0]. They were forced to withdraw from the final of the Valladolid Open in 2017 due to a Belasteguín injury, giving Navarro and Gutiérrez the title [d83147937s5p0]. With Belasteguín injured they missed the Mijas Open in 2017 and returned in the Gran Canaria Open where they exited in the quarterfinals [d83147937s5p0]. In 2019 they began the season with semifinal losses in the Marbella Master and the Logroño Open to Juan Lebrón and Paquito Navarro, and subsequently lost the Alicante Open final to the same pairing [d83147937s7p0]. At the 2019 Buenos Aires Master they reached the final but were forced to withdraw in the first set at 5–5 due to injury [d83147937s7p0].
